jobs.title: Software Engineer – SECS/GEM & Factory Automation
jobs.description:
About Insphere Technology
  
  

Insphere Technology is a Singapore\-based software company specialising in SECS/GEM connectivity and factory automation solutions for semiconductor equipment manufacturers and factories.
  
  

Our software is used globally to connect equipment with factory systems such as MES, EAP and other manufacturing applications.
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineer with practical SECS/GEM experience to develop equipment connectivity and factory automation software.
  
  

This is a coding\-focused role involving real\-time equipment communication, system integration, APIs and reusable software components.
  
  

Core Requirements — Mandatory
  
  

* Hands\-on experience with


SECS/GEM
  
  

* Strong


C\# / .NET
  
  

development skills
  
  

* Experience developing and consuming REST / Web APIs
* Familiar with AI\-assisted coding tools such as


Claude Code, Codex
  
  

, or similar development assistants
  
  

* Good understanding of object\-oriented design and software architecture
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills
* Comfortable working with asynchronous communication, networking and system integration


What You Will Work On
  
  

* Develop SECS/GEM equipment interfaces and communication protocols for semiconductor equipment integration
* Connect semiconductor equipment with MES, EAP, databases and factory systems
* Develop backend services and Web APIs using C\#/.NET
* Build reusable SDKs, libraries and communication components
* Develop simulators, diagnostic tools and engineering utilities
* Troubleshoot equipment communication and integration issues
* Work directly with customers and engineers to understand equipment behaviour and design suitable integration solutions


Advantageous Experience
  
  

**Experience in any of the following is a plus:**  

* GEM300
* Semiconductor equipment or factory automation
* WPF / MVVM
* OPC UA
* PLC communication
* TCP/IP, WebSockets or gRPC
* MES, EAP, SCADA, SPC or RMS systems
* Mitsubishi, Omron, Siemens or Beckhoff PLCs


Qualifications
  
  

Diploma or Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Electrical / Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics or related disciplines.
  
  

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who enjoys coding, understands SECS/GEM, and likes solving equipment connectivity problems.
  
  

INSPHERE TECHNOLOGY
  
  

is a Singapore\-based software innovation company established in 2010, delivering SECS/GEM connectivity and factory automation solutions (including legacy equipment/tools) in the semiconductor and photovoltaic industries.
  
  

We support global OEMs and semiconductor fabs with production\-proven software that enables smart factory integration, interoperability, and operational scalability.

**Job Title:**  

Software developer– Semiconductor Test (C\#, C\+\+, .NET)
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

Design, implement, and test system software in support of both the IG\-XL development environment for the UltraFLEX family platform and Eagle software for the ETS platform.
  
  

System software supports all digital, RF, and analog instruments, runs on various operating systems; this team architects and develops core services used by the driver teams.
  
  

The team also selects computing hardware that best matches product requirements and ensures that the software can run as a 64\-bit application.
  
  

Duties will include developing and analyzing software requirements, developing functional specifications and design documents based on the requirements, implementation of the code using C\#, C\+\+, .NET and COM/ATL, and unit testing and verification of the code.
  
  

The candidate will be responsible for debugging and solving complex software and computing issues.
  
  

The candidate will interface with several organizations (Factory Applications, Release Teams, Sustaining Teams, and other project Teams) on a daily basis.
  
  

**Minimum Requirements:**  

BSCS, BSCE, BSEE, or equivalent.
  
  

**Desired:** More than 5 years' experience with in\-depth software development experience with commercial applications.
  
  

Project work involving developing software applications that control hardware products.
  
  

Solid grasp of Object\-Oriented Design and software data structures; UML is desirable.
  
  

Proficiency in C\#, C\+\+, and OOD required.
  
  

Excellent written and verbal communication skills of complex systems is required.
  
  

Working knowledge of VB required.
  
  

Ability to work as part of a software development team required.
  
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**  

Knowledge of UML Design, Version Vault, and Git is a plus.
  
  

Ability to understand and debug a complex system is a plus.
  
  

Prior ATE experience and/or hardware knowledge is a plus.
  
  

Working knowledge of computing hardware is a plus.
  
  

Knowledge of Agile, CI, and JIRA is a plus

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Company

ISR Recruitment Limited is a reputable and forward-thinking recruitment agency specializing in connecting talented professionals with leading organizations across various industries. With a strong focus on technology and software development sectors, ISR Recruitment has built a reputation for delivering tailored recruitment solutions that meet the specific needs of both clients and candidates. The company prides itself on its comprehensive understanding of the evolving tech landscape, ensuring that it consistently identifies and attracts top-tier talent to support digital transformation and innovation initiatives. Committed to excellence, ISR Recruitment maintains a professional approach, fostering long-term relationships and ensuring the alignment of candidate skills with organizational goals.

About The Role

ISR Recruitment is collaborating with a prominent global software organization to recruit a highly skilled Senior Backend Engineer for its Product & Engineering team. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work on a next-generation B2B SaaS platform that is designed to be scalable, secure, and highly available. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in shaping the architecture and engineering standards of the platform, contributing to its ongoing evolution to meet the demands of a diverse, international client base. The position is ideal for an experienced engineer with a proven track record in delivering enterprise-level SaaS solutions, particularly within multi-tenant environments. The role provides a chance to influence technical strategy, work with cutting-edge technologies, and contribute to innovative product development in a dynamic, collaborative environment.

Qualifications

Over 8 years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong emphasis on backend development.
Extensive experience in delivering B2B SaaS products in a commercial setting.
Proven expertise working with multi-tenant SaaS platforms, ensuring scalability and security.
A consistent career progression with stability and long-term commitment within engineering teams.
Deep hands-on experience with C#, .NET Core, and modern .NET frameworks, ideally including .NET 8 and/or .NET 10.
Strong background in designing, building, and deploying production-grade software on the Microsoft technology stack.
Proficiency in developing RESTful APIs and backend services.
Experience working with relational databases, SQL, and cloud-based database solutions such as Azure SQL.
Knowledge of deploying and managing applications within cloud environments, particularly Microsoft Azure.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will be instrumental in designing, developing, and maintaining the core components of the company's cloud-native SaaS platform. Your responsibilities will include:

Designing, building, and maintaining robust backend services, APIs, and reusable libraries to support the platform’s features and integrations.
Writing high-quality, clean, and testable code using C# and the latest .NET technologies.
Participating in architectural discussions and decisions to ensure the platform remains scalable, secure, and resilient.
Developing RESTful APIs and backend services that are consumed by web and mobile clients, ensuring optimal performance and security.
Implementing event-driven and asynchronous components using technologies such as Azure Service Bus to facilitate scalable communication.
Working with relational databases to develop efficient SQL queries and database schemas.
Building and deploying cloud-based applications within Microsoft Azure, leveraging its services for scalability and reliability.
Participating in code reviews, automated testing, and adherence to engineering best practices to maintain high-quality standards.
Supporting continuous improvement initiatives, including refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt reduction.
Collaborating within an Agile environment, translating functional and technical requirements into robust software solutions.
Mentoring junior engineers, fostering a culture of excellence, and contributing to the elevation of engineering standards across the team.

Benefits

The successful candidate will receive a competitive salary ranging from approximately £60,000 to £80,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications. In addition to the base salary, the role offers comprehensive company benefits, which may include health insurance, pension contributions, flexible working arrangements, and professional development opportunities. The position is fully remote, allowing for flexible work arrangements within the UK and Ireland. The organization fosters a collaborative and innovative work environment, supporting continuous learning and career growth. Employees will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects with a global impact, shaping the future of SaaS technology and cloud-native solutions.

Equal Opportunity

ISR Recruitment Limited is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We celebrate individuality and are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe that diversity enriches our organization and drives innovation, and we encourage all qualified candidates to apply and join our clients in shaping the future of technology.

jobs.title: Azure Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Company

TEKsystems, a leading technology staffing and services provider, operates as part of the Allegis Group, one of the largest talent management firms globally. Known for its commitment to innovation and excellence, TEKsystems specializes in delivering comprehensive IT solutions, staffing, and consulting services to organizations across various industries. The company prides itself on fostering a collaborative and inclusive culture that emphasizes continuous learning, technical mastery, and client success. With a strong presence in the technology landscape, TEKsystems is dedicated to connecting talented professionals with impactful projects, helping organizations transform their digital capabilities and achieve strategic objectives.

About The Role

The Azure Engineer role at TEKsystems is a pivotal position designed for a seasoned professional with a deep understanding of cloud-native architectures and Microsoft Azure services. In this role, you will lead the design, development, and deployment of full-stack solutions on Azure, primarily utilizing Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). You will be responsible for setting the technical direction, ensuring the implementation of secure, resilient, and observable systems that are straightforward to operate in production environments. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of cloud technology, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative solutions that enhance business capabilities. You will be hands-on across the entire stack, mentoring team members, and driving best practices in engineering standards, security, and operational excellence.

Qualifications

To excel in this role, candidates should possess significant experience in senior or lead engineering positions, demonstrating a strong technical foundation in cloud-native development and operations. Essential qualifications include expertise in Java, particularly with Spring Boot, REST API development, and performance tuning. Proficiency in Python for service development, automation, and scripting is also required, with experience using frameworks like FastAPI or Flask. A proven track record of building and maintaining React-based front-end applications, preferably with TypeScript, modern hooks, and comprehensive testing strategies, is essential. Candidates must have practical experience managing workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), including deployments, ingress, autoscaling, and secrets management. Familiarity with containerization using Docker, CI/CD pipeline creation with Azure DevOps, and implementing release strategies such as blue/green and canary deployments are critical. A solid understanding of security practices, including role-based access control, secrets management, and identity protocols like OAuth2 and OIDC, is necessary. Additionally, experience with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform or Bicep, and knowledge of Azure services like ACR, Key Vault, Log Analytics, and Application Insights, will be advantageous.

Responsibilities

Lead the end-to-end delivery of full-stack applications, including React (TypeScript) front-end interfaces and Java/Python back-end services, focusing on microservices and API development.
Design and implement cloud-native solutions on AKS, defining service boundaries, resilience patterns, scaling approaches, deployment strategies, and operational readiness plans.
Develop and operate back-end services using Java (Spring Boot) and Python (FastAPI/Flask), ensuring optimal API design, performance, and security controls.
Create modern, accessible user interfaces with React, emphasizing reusable components, efficient state management, and robust testing.
Manage Kubernetes deployments on AKS, including manifests, ingress configurations, autoscaling policies, secrets management, and rollout/rollback procedures.
Implement DevSecOps practices through Azure DevOps, building CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, security scans, and dependency management.
Enhance observability by implementing logging, metrics, tracing, and creating actionable alerts, while defining SLOs and SLIs.
Embed security by design, applying secure coding practices, threat modeling, role-based access controls, secrets management, and identity protocols.
Mentor and coach engineering team members through code reviews, design discussions, and best practice sharing, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
Collaborate with product, architecture, UX, QA, and platform teams to ensure seamless delivery, risk management, and alignment with business goals.
Set clear technical direction, balancing delivery speed with long-term maintainability and sustainability.
Promote an inclusive and diverse engineering environment where varied perspectives are valued and leveraged to improve outcomes.
Take ownership of delivery commitments and production stability, focusing on root cause analysis and sustainable solutions rather than temporary fixes.
Facilitate automation, remove blockers, and streamline processes to maintain delivery momentum and high-quality output.

Benefits

Joining TEKsystems offers an engaging environment committed to professional growth and technical excellence. You will have access to ongoing learning opportunities, mentorship programs, and exposure to cutting-edge cloud technologies. The company fosters a collaborative culture that values innovation, inclusion, and work-life balance. Employees benefit from competitive compensation packages, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible work arrangements. Additionally, you will be part of a global network of professionals dedicated to making an impact through technology, with opportunities for career advancement and skill development in a dynamic, supportive setting.

Equal Opportunity

TEKsystems is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Company

Experis, a division of ManpowerGroup, is a global leader in professional resourcing and project-based workforce solutions. Renowned for connecting talented professionals with leading organizations across various industries, Experis specializes in IT, engineering, finance, and other specialized fields. With a strong commitment to innovation and excellence, the company provides tailored staffing solutions that drive business growth and digital transformation. Experis prides itself on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment, ensuring that both clients and candidates receive exceptional service and support. As a trusted partner in workforce solutions, Experis continuously seeks to attract top talent to meet the evolving needs of the modern workplace.

About The Role

We are seeking a skilled Cloud Engineer to join our dynamic team for a short-term engagement of three months. This role is based in London with a hybrid work model, combining remote work with on-site collaboration. The successful candidate will be responsible for translating cloud design specifications into reliable, secure, and governed infrastructure within Azure. You will work closely with a small, experienced team to develop and automate infrastructure deployment processes, emphasizing Infrastructure as Code, governance, and security best practices. This position offers an excellent opportunity for a hands-on professional to contribute to a critical cloud transformation project, ensuring the deployment of scalable, compliant, and efficient cloud solutions.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in cloud infrastructure development, particularly within the Azure environment. Proven experience in end-to-end cloud infrastructure delivery, including design, implementation, and testing, is essential. Practical knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as ARM templates, Terraform, or similar is required. A thorough understanding of cloud governance, policies, and role-based access control (RBAC) to ensure secure and compliant environments is necessary. Candidates should have hands-on experience provisioning and managing core Azure services, including networking, storage, key vaults, and virtual machines. Excellent collaboration skills and the ability to work within a small, focused team are also important. Relevant certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect or Azure Administrator are highly desirable.

Responsibilities

Design detailed low-level architectures for the target Azure cloud environment, aligning with project requirements and best practices.
Establish and configure an Infrastructure as Code platform to facilitate automated landing zone deployments, ensuring repeatability and consistency.
Create management groups, subscriptions, resource groups, and enforce Azure policies to maintain governance and compliance standards.
Implement and manage RBAC to control access securely across cloud resources.
Build, configure, and test network components, including load balancers, virtual networks, and security groups.
Provision and manage core Azure services such as storage accounts, key vaults, and file servers to support application and data needs.
Set up backup solutions and monitoring services to ensure high availability, security, and operational efficiency.
Provision virtual machines for various workloads, including application servers, middleware, and databases, with appropriate security controls.
Collaborate with team members to troubleshoot issues, optimize infrastructure, and implement best practices for cloud deployment.

Benefits

Joining Experis offers the opportunity to work on innovative cloud projects within a supportive and collaborative environment. The role provides competitive daily rates within IR35 regulations, along with the flexibility of a hybrid working model. You will gain valuable experience working alongside industry experts and contributing to critical infrastructure initiatives. The engagement allows for professional development in cloud architecture, automation, and governance, expanding your skill set and industry knowledge. Additionally, you will be part of a reputable organization committed to employee well-being and work-life balance, with access to resources and support tailored to your career growth.

Equal Opportunity

Experis is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances innovation and drives better business outcomes. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected status, and we encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.
